main_text.p: Nicephorum Callistum Xäthopulum Synaxario, quod legitur Dominica Resurrectionis, & Historia Ecclesiastica libro 1. capite 31. Matthæum Camariotam, Oratione in tres Hierarchas Basilium Cæsarienfem, Gregorium Nazianzenum, & Ioannem Chrysostomum. His superaddam Melodos Iosephum Canone in sanctum Abercium, Isidorum in sanctum Demetrium, Bartholomæum in Theodorum Martyrem, Basilium in sanctum Nicolaum, Germanum in sanctam Mariam Ægyptiacam, Ioannem in Romanum Melodum, Athanasium in sanctos Martyres Theodoros, in sanctum Ioannicium Iuniorem.

Nihilominus nunc quoque, cum similis argumenti prodigus campus, ex effertissima similium opimitate plene, & cumulate exultaret, duorum in ea gente pannychismum hunc afferentium principum, & quorum auctoritatem non configet, neque proteret Opponens, Marci Ephesij, cuius alibi de eodem pro Pontificijs sententiam adduximus, diversam tamen ab his, & Nicetæ Stethati testimonijs evincam, pannychismum hunc nullum esse in Orientali Ecclesia, sed somnium, atque intemperiem Schismaticorum, non sibi usquequaque con-stan-

page.notes: Long s is read as plain s throughout (printed as s, which looks like f in the scan). Printed forms such as "fanctum", "Bafilium", "Schifmaticorum" and "vfquequaque" are normalised accordingly. Line-end hyphens "Syna-", "Refurrectio-", "con-" and "stan-" are kept as printed. No doubtful readings.
